ambition.industrial_miracle.name: Industrial miracle
ambition.industrial_miracle.desc: Expand real national GDP by 15% above baseline to trigger a Golden Era of growth.
ambition.chokepoint_sovereign.name: Chokepoint sovereign
ambition.chokepoint_sovereign.desc: Keep maritime chokepoints open, trade access high and domestic markets free of shortages.
ambition.debt_free_treasury.name: Debt-free treasury
ambition.debt_free_treasury.desc: Lower sovereign debt below 25% of GDP while holding strong liquidity and credit confidence.
ambition.tech_hegemon.name: Tech hegemon
ambition.tech_hegemon.desc: Complete three new strategic technologies to vault national productivity forward.
ambition.peaceful_unifier.name: Peaceful unifier
ambition.peaceful_unifier.desc: Build a wide web of alliances, trade agreements and non-aggression pacts.
ambition.post_war_phoenix.name: Post-war phoenix
ambition.post_war_phoenix.desc: Clear war devastation across all regions and lift living standards above pre-crisis levels.
ambition.nuclear_peacemaker.name: Nuclear peacemaker
ambition.nuclear_peacemaker.desc: Sign a strategic arms control treaty or maintain calm deterrence alongside regional pacts.
ambition.clean_grid_pioneer.name: Clean-grid pioneer
ambition.clean_grid_pioneer.desc: Transition power generation to clean-grid methods or clean power stations with full grid supply.
ambition.maritime_lifeline.name: Maritime lifeline
ambition.maritime_lifeline.desc: Expand national ports and shipyards to secure oceanic trade reach and fleet capacity.
ambition.civic_renewal.name: Civic renewal
ambition.civic_renewal.desc: Raise living standards, calm regional radicalism and anchor durable domestic stability.
ambition.regional_powerhouse.name: Regional powerhouse
ambition.regional_powerhouse.desc: Modernize at least two industrial production methods while expanding national construction capacity.
ambition.export_powerhouse.name: Export powerhouse
ambition.export_powerhouse.desc: Grow real industrial output by 12% while running a positive weekly trade surplus.
directive.industrial_drive.name: Emergency industrial drive
directive.industrial_drive.desc: Accelerate contractor capacity (+0.35) and lift weekly productivity for 180 days.
directive.diplomatic_charm.name: Diplomatic charm offensive
directive.diplomatic_charm.desc: Boost relations with peaceful partners (+6 opinion) and restore political points weekly.
directive.anti_corruption.name: Anti-corruption purge
directive.anti_corruption.desc: Strengthen credit confidence (+4%) and stability (+2.5%) while curbing radicalism.
directive.strategic_reserve.name: Strategic reserve release
directive.strategic_reserve.desc: Cushion household living standards (+1.5%) and reinforce weekly stability for 120 days.
directive.national_cohesion.name: National cohesion campaign
directive.national_cohesion.desc: Rally stability (+3%) and war support (+4%) while reducing regional unrest.
directive.forward_logistics.name: Forward logistics mobilization
directive.forward_logistics.desc: Sharpen joint military experience and operational readiness across all branches.
